text:
maria: FYI sales ramp hit a snagSDRs are routing marketplace leads to SIs even when there's no prior engagement. we need a short 'claim window' policy to avoid burn.
sam: ok. current asks from sales: 1) how long does an SI get to claim a lead? 2) what qualifies as active SI engagement?
kevin: my quick take: claim window = 7 days after intake + required activity = one intro call or an email thread with buyer. if none -> auto-assign to redwood.
tara: +1 but for large accounts (>500k ARR) extend claim window to 14 days and auto-notify revenue leader.
sophie: can we make this machine-enforced? intake form should stamp source (marketplace / referral / SI) and start timer. ops-bot: automation note: we can add a webhook to create a "claim" flag and expire it.
ops-bot: planned action: create ticket in #si-intake when source==marketplace; label = "claim-window:7d" default. (reaction :gear:)
kevin: propose ruleset v0.1 (short):
```
priority rules:
1) if SI_has_signed_reseller_agreement == true AND last_engagement_days <= 90 -> SI_claim_window = 7d; initial_owner = SI
2) if SI_requested_claim_via_SDR == true -> SI_claim_window = 7d; requires intro_call
3) if source == marketplace AND no_SI_activity -> Redwood_owner after claim_window expires
4) enterprise_accounts (ARR >= 500k) -> claim_window = 14d; escalate to GTM exec on t+3d
```
maria: good. include hardware-integrator exception: if SI is delivering custom HW or appliance, SI gets automatic joint ownership until tech-ops sign-off.
sophie: also add tagging for "co-sell-announcement" boolean so marketing knows to prep joint logos and press plan if opportunity stage reaches negotiated terms.
kevin: crediting rules (proposal): if SI runs POC and closes => SI gets implementation credit + partner-origin credit for 12 months of ARR. revenue splits to be recorded in CRM field "partner_credit=%". example: partner_credit=100 -> partner gets origin credit 12m.
tara: need guardrails for dual-credit situations. if SI and Redwood both contributed to win -> split credit based on documented activities (sales motion checklist). keep it simple: activity points -> whoever > 60% gets origin.
maria: sample intake CSV header to enforce required fields for claims:
```
lead_id,source,account_name,ARR,SI_partner,SI_last_contact_days,claimed_until,claim_reason,marketing_tags
```
sophie: action items: kevin -> formalize ruleset doc and examples; maria -> add hardware exception language and marketing tag flow; tara -> update CRM fields + validation; sam -> implement webhook prototype with ops. owners by EOD Thursday?
kevin: i'll draft ruleset + 3 examples (marketplace-only, SI-engaged, hardware integrator) by Thursday noon PT.
maria: i'll write exception wording and a sample announcement checklist for marketing to review.
tara: i'll add the partner_credit field in CRM (readonly) and add a validation rule to block intake without required fields.
sam: will scope webhook today; target PR for automation in two weeks.
ops-bot: reminder set: "claim-window rules review" on 2025-05-02 09:00 PT.
sophie: once docs are in we'll run a 20m alignment with SDRs + SI leads. add any edge cases here (resellers that bundle HW + software, multi-SI accounts, SI subcontracting).
kevin: edge case note: subcontracted SI work requires primary SI to be recorded and any downstream SIs listed in "partner_chain" CRM field.
maria: thanks all 49c3fb. ill post the draft confluence link here when ready and ping GTM.
tara: thanks everyone. quick win: sam, can you add the claim-window tag to current backlog leads so we can test?
sam: yes running a dry-run now, will post results in #partnerships in ~30m.
